coordinatorSummary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Twenty-two attacks run, none landed. Custody holds: subject f1cdb568 at 0444, 9813 bytes, unmoved at both ends; HEAD never left 5d5d778; live required-now 26 of 26; file 08 and COORD unmodified. All five cited pins reproduce, recordedInputs.HEAD equals the top-level head, and artifact and version are both 1. The token is stated by the dispatch as a condition rather than a prohibition, so it was measured first: file08StatusToken is the bare string OPEN, the live DR-G27 status cell is OPEN, and no SATISFIED standing has leaked in — which matters with DR-131 and the Class A machinery adjacent. The assurance quote 'PROPOSED; not QUALIFIED' equals the live stage cell. Scope holds in both directions: D-153's adopted text reads that G27 owns DR-131 NT-6 only and that NT-6 leftover-design closes, G27 v1's entire NT usage is NT-6, and the join's namedClassesThisGate is exactly NT-6. I verified that closure in COORD rather than in the artifact, because it is what lets an obligation sit at leftoverDesign false. The strongest available probe was the G19 limb. G27 v1 carries three retained-evidence members, the third literally named 'not G19 durable state-byte class' with unauthored fixtures, and if that member's fixtures sat outside the single corpus this join names, the fixture obligation would be short — the DR-105 defect shape. All three members record suppliedBy as the same no-silent-promotion corpus class, so the one obligation covers every unauthored fixture. Null result, reported rather than left invisible. A second probe also came back clean and is worth the coordinator's attention as a positive: this join cites different source fields than its DR-G23 sibling, which could look like carelessness. It is the opposite. G27 v1 has no namedCorpusNotAuthored and no whatThisCloses at all, so the join cites liveHarnessCellVerbatim and authorityClaim — the fields that actually exist — and the corpus phrase it carries is a verbatim substring of that cell and matches the live file 08 harness cell. The artifact adapts to its source rather than filling a template. Two things recorded rather than raised: the join is silent on D-056 gates 2 and 3, which is correct for a gate row since asserting them would read as advancing DR-131 toward SATISFIED; and the DR-G27 harness cell still reads 'not authored' while G27 v1 exists — the eighth row in that condition, which my standing recommendation to dispose of the family in one act already covers.
